title: Explain what value-type and reference-type assignment copy, including shared reference fields

rubric.point: Replacement code preserves both initial settings: Attempts is copied from original.Attempts and Timeout from original.Limits.Timeout.
Replacement code gives retry a distinct Limits instance without replacing original.Limits.
Explains that assigning the struct copies its fields, so retry.Attempts is an independent int value.
Explains that the Limits field copies a reference to the same class instance, so mutating Timeout through that reference affects the shared object.
